rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for physically wrecking something so it is unusable.

example.english: They managed to destroy the computer with one kick.
example.traditional: 佢哋一腳就搞爛咗部電腦。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 goek3 zau6 gaau2 laan6 zo2 bou6 din6 nou5

rows.note: Use this when a quality, effect, or condition is spoiled or neutralized rather than an object being smashed.

example.english: Heavy rain can destroy the atmosphere at a wedding.
example.traditional: 落大雨會破壞婚禮嘅氣氛。
example.jyutping: lok6 daai6 jyu5 wui5 po3 waai6 fan1 lai5 ge3 hei3 fan1

rows.note: Use this for severely ruining a person's well-being or bringing someone down.

example.english: Staying up late for a long time can destroy your health.
example.traditional: 長期捱夜會搞垮你個身體。
example.jyutping: coeng4 kei4 ngaai4 je6 wui5 gaau2 kwaa1 nei5 go3 san1 tai2

rows.note: Use this mainly when a team or competitor defeats another by a huge margin.

example.english: We went on to destroy our opponents eight-nil yesterday.
example.traditional: 我哋噚日大炒對手八比零。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 cam4 jat6 daai6 caau2 deoi3 sau2 baat3 bei2 ling4
